These files are from JSONTestSuite by Nicolas Seriot,
https://github.com/nst/JSONTestSuite, at commit
1ef36fa01286573e846ac449e8683f8833c5b26a, under the MIT license in
`LICENSE`. The suite accompanies Seriot's article "Parsing JSON is a
Minefield", https://seriot.ch/projects/parsing_json.html.

A file in `test_parsing` named y_ must be accepted, n_ must be rejected,
and i_ may be either. `test_transform` holds inputs whose decoded value
parsers disagree on. The files are unchanged.
